subject: Request: SafeCare case study + logo usage for product spotlight
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Khan <amy.khan@safecarehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-18T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SafeCare case study + logo usage for product spotlight

Hi Amy —

Thanks again for the great demo last week. As discussed, we'd love to publish a short customer spotlight that highlights SafeCare's work with Redwood Inference: an approx. 500–700 word case study for the Redwood website and a short one‑slide quote for sales decks.

Attached is a draft case study (Draft_CaseStudy_v1.pdf) and a suggested short quote pulled from your email with John. Two quick asks: 1) permission to use SafeCare name and logo in the web case study and slide deck; 2) approval on the short quote (or an edited version).

Planned usage: website case study, marketing blog post, slide deck for sales/BD, and a tweet announcing the spotlight. If you need a restricted scope (e.g., web only), please let me know.

Would it help if I sent a simple logo use agreement for legal to sign? Happy to route a DocuSign.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Draft_CaseStudy_v1.pdf

From: Amy Khan <amy.khan@safecarehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marketing@safecarehealth.com, legal@safecarehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-19T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SafeCare case study + logo usage for product spotlight

Hi Evelyn —

Really excited to see this — the draft looks solid. Marketing is generally fine with the topics and the quote, but we need Legal to sign off on logo usage and the exact phrasing of the customer quote. Looping in Tim (Legal) and Marketing Ops.

I attached our current brand guidelines for reference (SafeCare_Brand_Guidelines.pdf). A couple of notes from Marketing:
- Please use the horizontal logo on white for the web hero; we prefer the dark-blue accent color for the pull quote.
- Keep the quote attribution as: "John Alvarez, Head of Data Science, SafeCare Health" (if that's ok with Sales).

If you can send a short logo agreement or the exact clause we need to sign, Tim can review quickly.

Thanks — Amy
Amy Khan
Sr. Manager, Customer Marketing | SafeCare Health
amy.khan@safecarehealth.com

Attachment: SafeCare_Brand_Guidelines.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Khan <amy.khan@safecarehealth.com>, Tim Lee <legal@safecarehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SafeCare case study + logo usage for product spotlight

Hi Amy / Tim —

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attaching a concise Logo Use Agreement (Logo_Use_Agreement_Draft.pdf) that covers: permitted assets (web case study, marketing blog, sales slide deck, social), duration (18 months), and a simple indemnity/attribution clause. Please feel free to redline.

Jonas: adding you for any technical clarifications on our side about where the asset will be stored and how the logo will be used in a slide template. Marissa: if Marketing wants to tweak the quote, we can update the draft.

Next steps proposed:
1) Tim/legal to redline agreement or approve
2) SafeCare to provide final logo files (EPS/SVG) and sign the agreement (we can use DocuSign)
3) Redwood to publish on staging for review, then go live on the 29th (tentative)

Let me know if any of those are blockers.

Best,
Evelyn
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Logo_Use_Agreement_Draft.pdf

From: Tim Lee <legal@safecarehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: amy.khan@safecarehealth.com, marketing@safecarehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-21T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SafeCare case study + logo usage for product spotlight

Evelyn —

Thanks for sending. Reviewed the draft. Legal is ok with the general scope but we have two quick redlines:
1) Change duration from 18 months to "until either party provides written notice" (we prefer an open-ended clause with a 30‑day termination right).
2) Remove the broad indemnity language; replace with limited indemnity for IP misuse and willful misconduct.

Also please send the vector logo files (EPS/SVG) and specify the canonical trademark notices you want to include. I attached a marked-up PDF with the redlines (Logo_Consent_Redlines.pdf). Once those edits are made we'll sign via DocuSign.

Regards,
Tim Lee
Counsel | SafeCare Health
legal@safecarehealth.com

Attachment: Logo_Consent_Redlines.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tim Lee <legal@safecarehealth.com>, Amy Khan <amy.khan@safecarehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-22T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SafeCare case study + logo usage for product spotlight

Hi Tim / Amy —

Thanks for the quick review and the redlines, Tim — we made the two edits you requested (terminated-by-notice clause + narrowed indemnity) and uploaded the final DocuSign envelope. Link: https://app.docusign.com/RECIPIENT/123456

Also attaching the signed consent once countersigned (Signed_Logo_Consent.pdf). SafeCare logo files received and placed in our marketing drive for the design team.

Marissa — we plan to publish on staging tomorrow (2027-04-23) and go live 2027-04-29 pending SafeCare final look. Can you confirm timeline on your end?

Appreciate the fast collaboration — excited to get this live.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Signed_Logo_Consent.pdf
